MAR.note: Decree 2.26.831 gives the new ministry AI policy and coordination duties only; no rule or authority over AI harms is stated.
Nothing on a government body using an AI system.

facts.fact: Analyst Amal Hamsas writes that Morocco has no legislative text governing AI as a whole, its framework resting on dispersed existing laws; the draft framework law Digital X.0 is only at preparatory work.

MAR.note: Nothing on AI in a public sector system.
Nothing on AI built or hosted in Morocco.

facts.fact: The article lists law no. 05-20 on cybersecurity among Morocco's laws in force.
The article lists law no. 07-03 on offences against automated data processing systems among Morocco's laws in force.
The article lists law no. 09-08 on protection of individuals in personal data processing among Morocco's laws in force.

MAR.note: ISO/IEC 42001 is cited as a general standard, not as adopted or required in Morocco.
Nothing on public bodies sharing data; law 43-20 is on trust services for electronic transactions.
